run_ids_only.sql:
SELECT runs.id 
FROM runs 
WHERE runs.id IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_id_1]) AND (CAST((runs.context ->> %(context_1)s) AS VARCHAR) = %(param_1)s OR CAST(((runs.result -> %(result_1)s) ->> %(param_2)s) AS VARCHAR) = %(param_3)s)

marked_contract_ids.sql:
SELECT run_contracts.run_id 
FROM run_contracts 
WHERE run_contracts.run_id IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_run_id_1]) AND (EXISTS (SELECT anon_1.value 
FROM json_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN (json_typeof(((run_contracts.snapshot -> %(snapshot_1)s) -> %(param_1)s)) = %(json_typeof_1)s) THEN (run_contracts.snapshot -> %(snapshot_1)s) -> %(param_1)s ELSE %(param_2)s::JSON END) AS anon_1(value) 
WHERE anon_1.value = %(value_1)s))
